rationale: Twelfth turn: the cluster harness now carries two further cases on the decision-formation axis, in addition to the stale-decided case it already held. Case batched_mixed_proposals (three nodes, batch_size 4, eight entries proposed on the leader and eight on a follower) checks that every node reports the same decided vector, that the values are exactly the proposed ones, and that the entry readable at each index equals the reported element for that index. Case leader_change_prefix decides a six-entry prefix, removes the leader, elects a replacement, appends four more entries and recovers the old leader from its persisted storage, checking that the decided prefix is unchanged on every node before and after the recovery. Both cases were run locally and their declared properties held, which answers the two open decision-formation questions with measured bounds rather than leaving them open; the stale-decided case still reproduces its abort in the same run.

scope.description: One test target with three deterministic in-process cases over real OmniPaxos instances driven by explicit tick and route steps: (a) batched_mixed_proposals - three nodes, batch_size 4, eight entries proposed on the leader and eight on a follower, compared for identical decided vectors, complete proposed-value coverage and index/content consistency; (b) leader_change_prefix - three nodes, batch_size 2, a decided prefix, removal of the leader, election of a replacement, further entries, then recovery of the old leader from its persisted storage, compared for prefix preservation and identical vectors; (c) stale_decided_vs_compacted_follower - the previously established recovery/compaction case, unchanged.
assumptions: Node pids {1,2,3}, configuration_id 1, majority quorum, deterministic message routing; no threads, no timers, no network.

Crash is modelled by removing the instance while keeping its storage handle, and recovery by rebuilding from that handle; the durable state is therefore the state the node had written before the crash.
Decision comparison reads the decided suffix through the public API while nothing is compacted in the two new cases, so element positions correspond to log indices.
Dev profile with overflow checks enabled, matching the controller's cargo test invocation.
excluded: Snapshot-capable entry types and the persistent backend are not exercised by these two cases (they are covered by the contrast experiment).
Larger clusters, other quorum shapes, concurrent multi-leader proposals and message reordering beyond the deterministic schedule are not exercised.

experiment.prefix: Cluster::new(nodes, batch_size) builds OmniPaxos instances (pids 1,2,3) over shared in-memory storage handles and pump_until ticks and routes until a (Leader, Accept) exists. Case (a): with batch_size 4 the harness appends TestEntry(0..8) on the elected leader and TestEntry(100..108) on one follower, then pump_until every node reports decided_idx 16; it then collects each node's decided vector via read_decided_suffix(0), compares the three vectors, compares the sorted values with the proposed multiset, and for every node and index checks that read(idx) returns the vector element at that index, emitting case_result_batched. Case (b): with batch_size 2 it appends TestEntry(0..6) on the leader, waits until all nodes report decided_idx 6, emits leader_change_admitted with the prefix, removes the leader instance, pump_until a new (Leader, Accept) exists, appends TestEntry(200..204) on the new leader, waits until all surviving nodes report decided_idx 10, and emits case_result_leader_change with the new leader's identity, prefix preservation and vector equality; it then rebuilds the old leader from its storage handle and pump_until every node reports decided_idx 10 with equal vectors, emitting case_result_leader_change_recovered. Case (c) is unchanged from the earlier revision and emits setup, case_admitted, trim_applied, new_leader_established, log_sync_outcome and run_summary.
semantic_changes: No production logic is replaced or patched; the harness uses the crate's public API only. The helpers added for the new cases read decided entries through read_decided_suffix/read.
experiment.responsibility: For case (a) the responsibility under test is the leader's batched accept path and each follower's batched append together with the reported accepted index; for case (b) it is the synchronisation and adoption path used after a leader change and on recovery; case (c) keeps the previously asserted responsibility for the below-compaction log-update request.
experiment.revision_reason: Follow-up basis: this revision returns to the cluster harness and adds two decision-formation cases (batched mixed proposals; leader change plus recovery of the old leader) to the recovery case it already carries, so the contract between the reported accepted index and the entries a node holds, and the adoption path after a leader change, are both measured in the same target. The preceding contrast revision remains the fixed artifact for the branch-selection and backend questions.

comparisons.description: Stale-decided case (unchanged): the healthy follower handles the stale node's Prepare without aborting.
With batch_size 4 and concurrent leader/follower proposals, every node reports the same decided vector.
Each node's entry readable at index i equals the element that node reports for index i.
After removing the leader and electing a replacement, the decided prefix is unchanged on every surviving node.
The old leader, rebuilt from its persisted storage, converges to the same decided vector as the survivors.

knowledge.assertion: the non-snapshot branch reads get_suffix(common_prefix_idx) with no comparison against the responder's compacted index
